rules.rule: Government-published programme statistics may be shown as authoritative snapshots when the exact source URL and retrieval timestamp are retained.
Programme statistics are not a substitute for an individual Record of Rights, Jamabandi, mutation, cadastral map, title record, or ownership determination.
Legacy BHAVANINFO parcel/building records remain synthetic_demo until their provenance and underlying source records are established.
AI, reconstruction, floor segmentation, discrepancy detection and other processing outputs must identify the input dataset, processing version and model/pipeline.
Aadhaar authentication is an identity/authentication operation and does not establish land ownership, title or RoR rights.
